identification: Taxidermy hazel grouse (Tetrastes bonasia), a Eurasian woodland gamebird, mounted on a driftwood base, about 26 cm high
searches_tried: | chrome: WebSearch x3: taxidermy hazel grouse mount sold auction; hazel grouse facts; hazel grouse taxidermy for sale price. Burstow & Hewett lot opened turned out to be a puffin (GBP 130 hammer), not comparable, not recorded. No hazel grouse price found.
viewing_check: Hazel grouse do not occur in Australia, so this is an imported or old European mount. Check for a taxidermist or dealer label, moth or feather damage, and ask about import paperwork if you plan to resell or export it.
